items.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
items.summary: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

items.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
items.summary: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

items.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
items.summary: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours battery life.

items.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
items.summary: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

items.title: Enveda secures $311M to bring more nature-derived AI drugs into clinical trials
items.summary: The round valued the AI biotech at $2 billion. It is currently testing drugs that treat skin conditions and preserve weight loss after stopping GLP-1s.

items.title: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
items.summary: Pro and Plus users will be able to use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks.

items.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
items.summary: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.

items.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
items.summary: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.

items.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
items.summary: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.

items.title: StrictlyVC at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Inside the changing rules of venture capital
items.summary: StrictlyVC joins TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to discuss the changing VC landscape thanks to AI. Get your Investor Pass to join these exclusive sessions. Save $200 before September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

items.title: YouTube releases new AI features for creators within its Studio app
items.summary: YouTube is adding new features to generate ideas and monitor the performance of thumbnails.

items.summary: 3 days to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, plus 50% off a second. Make impactful connections with 10,000+ tech leaders. Last day to save is September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Register today.

items.title: Spotify is giving you the keys to its recommendation algorithm with US launch of ‘Taste Profile’
items.summary: Spotify is rolling out Taste Profile to Premium users in the U.S., letting listeners see how the streamer understands their tastes and use natural language to reshape their recommendations.

items.title: Ema raises $77M as AI starts eating into enterprise software and services
items.summary: Ema has raised $140 million to date and has more than 50 enterprise customers, including Google and Microsoft.

items.title: ‘We’re already fighting yesterday’s battle’: Greece’s prime minister gets candid about AI
items.summary: Most leaders on a trade mission stick to the pitch, but when I interviewed Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis this week, he also admitted that no government is ready for what AI is about to do.

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit’s agenda revealed: Unlock fundraising, hiring, and AI insights in Boston on November 4
items.summary: Founders shouldn't have to learn the hardest lessons the hardest way. TechCrunch Founder Summit is designed to make the challenges of starting a company easier and the highs that much greater.

items.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms
items.summary: The seven-year-old startup has raised a $350 million Series E to fuel its data-as-a-service approach.

items.title: Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI
items.summary: Qualcomm said that its new top chip can run 30B mixture-of-expert model locally.

items.title: Meta admits Muse’s likeness to OpenClaw isn’t a coincidence
items.summary: Meta says Muse was built from scratch, but acknowledges the AI assistant was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw — down to some of its workspace filenames and content.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
items.summary: OpenAI is launching two new models, which it says are cut from the same cloth as Astra.
